outcome_evidence: The drawer is initially closed (frame 0, left_ego_image). The robot approaches and aligns its fingers around the handle (frames 40–85, wrist_image), then pulls the drawer outward, exposing its side and the opening above it (frames 105–127, image and left_ego_image). The drawer remains visibly open as the gripper releases and withdraws (frames 130–147, left_ego_image and wrist_image). No failed attempt or unintended side effect is visibly established.
